node.statement: The fixed lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge witness package and W.e_cross<=min{e_cross^0,e_3}, together with the respective producer smallness and bijectivity hypotheses, apply to that exact datum and yield its literal u_3:B_U oplus B_V->A_R as an extended D_3 t-isomorphism with ||u_3(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=D_3 t; since 0<=t and D_3<=D_*, both defect bounds weaken to D_*t.
